metadata.description: E2-A mini demo: 100 of the 110 prefix sentences; per sentence the labelled candidate rows (label 1=ERROR) with frozen label-free scores (every score higher = more likely ERROR) and rename controls.

examples.input: If an object is a smartphone, it must be a mobile device that combines the functions of a cellphone, computer, and personal digital assistant, often featuring internet access and touchscreen display.
A room is well lit if it has natural light or is illuminated by artificial lights, but not if the lights are too dim.
If Xiomara either wakes up at dawn or has light slumber (but not both), then she sleeps very lightly.
An item is a skateboard when it is a wheeled platform, used for performing tricks or navigating urban terrain, and requires the rider to balance and maneuver the board by shifting their weight.

rows.candidate_fol: ∀x (Skateboard(x) ↔ (WheeledPlatform(x) ∧ (UsedFor(x, performingTricks) ∨ UsedFor(x, navigatingUrbanTerrain)) ∧ Requires(x, balancing) ∧ Requires(x, maneuveringByShiftingWeight)))
rows.label: ERROR

rows.candidate_fol: ∀x (Item(x) → (WheeledPlatform(x) ∧ UsedFor(x, performingTricks) ∧ UsedFor(x, navigatingUrbanTerrain) ∧ Requires(x, balance) ∧ Requires(x, maneuver) ∧ Requires(x, shiftingWeight)))
rows.label: ERROR

rows.candidate_fol: ∀x (Skateboard(x) ↔ (WheeledPlatform(x) ∧ (UsedFor(x, performingTricks) ∨ UsedFor(x, navigatingUrbanTerrain)) ∧ Requires(x, rider, balance) ∧ Requires(x, rider, maneuver, board, shift, weight)))
rows.label: ERROR

rows.candidate_fol: ∀x ((WheeledPlatform(x) ∧ (UsedFor(x, performingTricks) ∨ UsedFor(x, navigatingUrbanTerrain)) ∧ Requires(x, riderBalance) ∧ Requires(x, riderManeuver)) → Skateboard(x))
rows.label: ERROR

rows.candidate_fol: ∀x (Skateboard(x) ↔ (WheeledPlatform(x) ∧ (UsedFor(x, tricks) ∨ UsedFor(x, urbanTerrain)) ∧ Requires(x, balance) ∧ Requires(x, weightShifting)))
rows.label: ERROR

rows.candidate_fol: ∀x ((WheeledPlatform(x) ∧ (UsedFor(x, performingTricks) ∨ UsedFor(x, navigatingUrbanTerrain)) ∧ Requires(x, RiderBalanceAndManeuverByWeightShift)) → Skateboard(x))
rows.label: ERROR

rows.candidate_fol: ∀x (Item(x) ∧ (WheeledPlatform(x) ∧ UsedFor(x, performingTricks) ∧ UsedFor(x, navigatingUrbanTerrain)) → (Requires(x, rider) ∧ Requires(x, balancing) ∧ Requires(x, shiftingWeight)))
rows.label: ERROR

examples.input: A party is enjoyable if there is good music or delicious food, but not if it is overcrowded.
If a creature regenerates cells and maintains balance, then it can live in a stable form.

A substance that increases the rate of a chemical reaction without being consumed in the process is a catalyst.
If Albert either follows traditional methods or values handcrafting (but not both), then he is a craftsman.

rows.candidate_fol: (∀x (Albert(x) ∧ (Follows(x, traditionalMethods) ∨ Values(x, handcrafting)) → ¬Both(x, follows, values))) → Craftsman(x)

examples.input: A landform characterized by a steep, towering rock formation, located near a body of water, and frequently inhabited by nesting seabirds is a sea stack.

If Queenie either breaks down cells or absorbs organic matter (but not both), then she feeds on nutrients.

A bird is a skilled flyer if it can perform acrobatic maneuvers or has exceptional speed, but not if it has injured wings or is primarily flightless.
If Uriah is either environmentally negligent or cares about wildlife (but not both), then he makes green choices.
A star x belongs to constellation y and is visible from location z if x is a part of y and can be seen in the sky from z.
A dessert is satisfying if it is sweet or fruity, has a pleasant texture, and is visually appealing, but not if it is overly caloric.
If Reece either seeks a global perspective or fosters social connections (but not both), then she rejects inbreeding.
A fertile agricultural land that features nutrient-rich soil, access to fresh water, and favorable climate conditions can support high crop yields and maintain food security.
A vacation is relaxing if there are beautiful sights and comfortable accommodations, but not if it is too noisy.

If Callahan either experiences fatigue or requires medication (but not both), then he has a chronic condition.
A food item is considered high in fiber if it contains a significant amount of soluble or insoluble dietary fiber and contributes to daily recommended intake.
It's possible for a meal to be vegetarian and gluten-free, but not all meals are.
If Abdullah either explores cultures or tries new adventures (but not both), then he seeks new experiences.
A structure is a bridge if it spans a physical obstacle, such as a body of water or a road, and provides a passage for transportation.
Cats are mammals with retractable claws, dogs are mammals with a keen sense of smell, and snakes are reptiles without retractable claws or a keen sense of smell.
For all people, if they either think critically or have attention to detail, then they value precision.
A flashlight illuminates a dark area by emitting light from a bulb, while a glowstick illuminates a dark area by emitting light through a chemical reaction.
A fruit is edible and can be sweet or sour, while a vegetable is edible but not typically sweet.
If Lauryn either listens actively or provides support (but not both), then she is a good psychiatrist.
A bee pollinates a flower when it collects nectar and transfers pollen from the male part of a flower to the female part of another flower.
A renewable energy source like solar, wind, or hydropower generates electricity without depleting natural resources and contributes to reducing greenhouse gas emissions.
If Gabriella is either a meticulous editor or a talented writer (but not both), then she is a respected authority.
If an object is a guitar, it must be a musical instrument with a hollow or solid body, a neck, and strings that produce sound when plucked or strummed.
A medical procedure is deemed successful when the patient recovers without complications and achieves the desired outcome.
If Kinsley either explores new topics or investigates deeper (but not both), then she is curious.

Some medications require a prescription, while others are available over the counter without a prescription.
If Rosalyn either exposes abuse or uncovers scandals (but not both), then she fights corruption.

rows.candidate_fol: ∀x (Rosalyn(x) → ((Expose(x, abuse) ∨ Uncover(x, scandals)) ∧ ¬(Expose(x, abuse) ∧ Uncover(x, scandals)) → Fight(x, corruption)))
rows.label: ERROR

examples.input: A smartphone connects to the internet and enables communication through voice calls, text messages, and various applications, such as email, social media, or video conferencing.
A natural resource that is replenished over time and can be used repeatedly without depletion is a renewable resource.
If Reign either reduces waste or conserves water (but not both), then he is eco-conscious.
A telescope gathers light from distant objects, such as stars and galaxies, and focuses the light onto a detector, like a camera or the human eye, for observation.
A robot x navigates through a maze y when it successfully identifies and follows the correct path without encountering any dead ends.
If Hunter either swims effortlessly or finds food easily (but not both), then he thrives in his environment.
A vehicle is considered an airplane if it has wings, is powered by engines, and is capable of flight through the air and navigation above the ground.
A dessert is frozen if it's served cold, baked if it's cooked in an oven, and raw if it's made without cooking or freezing.
If Caspian either meditates daily or practices yoga (but not both), then she will find inner peace.
A telescope is suitable for stargazing if it has a high magnification, clear optics, and a sturdy mount, but not if it is difficult to set up.
An organization is a charity if its primary goal is to provide assistance or raise funds for those in need without profit.
If Heath either thinks critically or questions authority (but not both), then he inspires nonconformity.
An exercise routine is effective if it improves cardiovascular health or builds muscle, but it is not effective if it leads to injury or causes excessive fatigue.
A non-stop flight travels directly from the departure airport to the destination airport without any layovers.
If Jake either uses a water filter or purifies water chemically (but not both), then he boils water before drinking.
A building qualifies as a museum if it houses a collection of artifacts or art, serves as an educational or cultural institution, and is open to the public.
A device is wireless if it can transmit and receive data or signals without the need for physical cables or wires.
Anyone who shares cooking tips or builds an online presence can become a culinary influencer.
In a football match, if one team scores more goals than the other team, the team with more goals wins, and the other team loses.

rows.candidate_fol: ∀t ∀team1 ∀team2 (FootballMatch(t) ∧ ScoresMoreGoals(team1, team2, t) → (Wins(team1, t) ∧ Loses(team2, t)))
rows.label: ERROR

rows.candidate_fol: ∀x ∀y (Team(x) ∧ Team(y) ∧ InMatch(x, y) ∧ ScoresMoreGoals(x, y) → (Wins(x) ∧ Loses(y)))
rows.label: ERROR

rows.candidate_fol: ∀x∀y∀z∀w ((FootballMatch(x) ∧ Team(y) ∧ Team(z) ∧ Scores(y, w) ∧ Scores(z, w) ∧ GreaterThan(w, w)) → (Wins(y) ∧ Loses(z)))
rows.label: ERROR

examples.input: A restaurant that serves vegetarian meals must include options without any meat or animal byproducts.
A musical instrument that has strings, is played with a bow, and can be held between the chin and shoulder is a violin if it has four strings.

rows.candidate_fol: ∀x ((MusicalInstrument(x) ∧ HasStrings(x) ∧ PlayedWith(x, bow) ∧ CanBeHeldBetween(x, chin, shoulder) ∧ HasNumStrings(x, four)) → Violin(x))
rows.label: CORRECT

rows.candidate_fol: ∀x ((Strings(x) ∧ PlayedWith(x, bow) ∧ HeldBetween(x, chin, shoulder)) → (FourStrings(x) → Violin(x)))

examples.input: A software x is compatible with an operating system y if x can function properly and without errors on y.
If Aubree is either a conventional thinker or an unconventional thinker (but not both), then she is innovative.
A beverage is an alcoholic drink if it contains ethanol, is produced by fermentation, and has a percentage of alcohol by volume (ABV) greater than 0.5%.

If Wyatt either designs frameworks or builds prototypes (but not both), then he develops models.

If Mary either reads novels or listens to music (but not both), then she enjoys alone time.

rows.candidate_fol: ∀x ∀y ((Store(x) ∧ Order(y) ∧ TotalCostExceeds(y, threshold) ∧ ¬Oversized(y) ∧ ¬DestinationIs(y, remote)) → OfferFreeShipping(x, y))
rows.label: ERROR

rows.candidate_fol: ∀x (Store(x) ∧ Order(y) ∧ TotalCost(y, z) ∧ Exceeds(z, threshold) ∧ ¬OversizedItems(y) ∧ ¬RemoteDestination(y) → OfferFreeShipping(x, y))
rows.label: ERROR

examples.input: A train x connects station y to station z if x departs from y and arrives at z without any transfers.

rows.candidate_fol: ∃x (Train(x) ∧ Connects(x, y, z) ∧ DepartFrom(x, y) ∧ ArriveAt(x, z) ∧ ∀w (Transfer(x, w) → False))
rows.label: ERROR

rows.candidate_fol: ∀x∀y∀z (Train(x) ∧ Station(y) ∧ Station(z) ∧ DepartsFrom(x, y) ∧ ArrivesAt(x, z) ∧ ¬∃w (Station(w) ∧ HasTransfer(x, w)) → Connects(x, y, z))
rows.label: ERROR

rows.candidate_fol: ∀x∀y∀z (Train(x) ∧ Station(y) ∧ Station(z) ∧ DepartsFrom(x, y) ∧ ArrivesAt(x, z) ∧ ¬RequiresTransfer(x) → Connects(x, y, z))
rows.label: ERROR

rows.candidate_fol: ∀x ∀y ∀z ((Train(x) ∧ Station(y) ∧ Station(z) ∧ DepartsFrom(x, y) ∧ ArrivesAt(x, z) ∧ ¬∃w (TransferAt(x, w))) → Connects(x, y, z))
